mapper.select: SELECT cl.seq, cl.detail, cl.regdate, TO_CHAR(cl.regdate, 'HH24:MI') AS messageTime, m.nickname, m.seqMember, CASE WHEN m.seqMember = #{loginUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mine FROM chat_log cl INNER JOIN member m ON cl.seqMember = m.seqMember WHERE cl.seqChattingroom = #{roomId} ORDER BY cl.regdate ASC, cl.seq ASC
